description: Read a YouTube transcript or reuse an imported X, Instagram, TikTok, generic, or local-file transcript in summary, key moments, chapters, or paginated full mode. Default mode is key_moments. Full mode returns plain transcript text (not timestamped segments) paged by offset/limit, which count UTF-16 code units of that text — not seconds or lines. To read a whole transcript, call mode=full with offset 0 (e.g. offset 0, limit 15000), then repeat with longVideoHandling.pagination.nextOffset until hasMore is false. An explicit full request over 32000 characters without offset/limit is downgraded to key_moments. If a starting offset is adjusted to avoid splitting a character, the response reports requestedOffset alongside the offset actually used. [~1-3s]

includeTimestamps.description: Include timestamps in structured modes (summary, key_moments, chapters). Ignored by full mode, which returns text rather than timestamped segments.

limit.description: Full mode only: page size in UTF-16 code units (1000-64000, default 32000).

mode.description: Default key_moments. full returns paginated plain text; summary, key_moments, and chapters return structured sections.

offset.description: Full mode only: start position in the transcript text as a UTF-16 code-unit offset (not seconds or line count). Use longVideoHandling.pagination.nextOffset from the previous page.

name: readTranscript
